visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a large, dimly lit banquet hall adorned with warm chandeliers and red LED wall accents, a bride stands in the center of a circular dance floor. She is wearing a voluminous, shimmering ball gown in shades of gold, purple, and soft pink, and her hair is intricately styled with floral ornaments. She holds a microphone and addresses a large group of formally dressed guests standing in a circle around her. Two small children, a boy and a girl in white formal attire, stand close to her in the foreground. (2) The bride gestures enthusiastically to the crowd, her facial expression bright and animated. The groom, dressed in a sharp white tuxedo jacket with a black bowtie, stands by her side, occasionally smiling and looking at the guests. Many guests are seen holding white cloth napkins, ready for instruction. The camera remains handheld and close to the central figures, capturing the intimate yet grand atmosphere. (3) The bride raises a selfie stick attached to a 360-degree camera while the guests begin to twirl their white napkins in the air in a synchronized motion. The lighting shifts to more dramatic spotlights as everyone cheers. The bride herself begins to spin rapidly in place, creating a whirlwind effect with her gown. (4) A black screen transition appears with a white line-art icon of a smartphone and the text 'ROTATE YOUR PHONE' in all-caps white font. The icon and text rotate 90 degrees to indicate a shift to horizontal viewing. (5) The video transitions to a wide-angle, circular perspective showing the full 360-degree view of the ballroom. The bride and groom spin together in the center while the surrounding circle of dozens of guests wave their white napkins vigorously. The camera movement is a rapid, stabilized rotation that follows the bride's spin, creating a dizzying, festive, and immersive visual experience.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The bride wears a multi-colored shimmering gown (gold, purple, pink) with floral hair accents. The groom wears a white tuxedo jacket and black trousers.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A luxury hotel banquet hall with high ceilings, large decorative light fixtures, and a custom-printed dance floor with elegant script. The walls feature red LED strips and large display screens.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio sequence begins with the bride speaking loudly and excitedly into a microphone, her voice characterized by high pitch and bright resonance. A lively pop-electronic music track with a strong four-on-the-floor beat swells in the background. The speech is punctuated by brief pauses, with a low-level ambient room tone of the banquet hall audibly present beneath her words. (2) As the bride encourages the crowd, the intensity of the BGM increases, featuring shimmering synth pads and a prominent drum rhythm. A sudden burst of cheering and laughter from the guests creates a dense layer of high-arousal vocal noise that masks the quieter details of the room tone. The bride's vocal delivery remains fast and energized. (3) The speaking segment ends, and the audio shifts focus to the high-energy music track with clear female vocals in English. Rhythmic crowd applause and cheering coincide with the musical beat, creating a powerful percussive texture. A subtle whoosh sound effect marks a transition in the visual editing pace. (4) The final phase is dominated by a crescendo of music and collective human cheering. The acoustic environment is bright and expansive, with strong percussive transients from the electronic drums. The audio maintains high spectral brightness and dynamic energy until a final swell that fades into the conclusion.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a unique and high-energy wedding moment where the bride, identifying as a content creator, directs her guests to participate in a choreographed 360-degree video shot. The intent is to showcase her creative personality and the joyous atmosphere of the wedding through an impressive, tech-assisted visual 'reel'.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The presence of the 'Shoot by Insta360 X3' text overlay and the direct demonstration of the camera's signature 360-degree rotation feature serves as a product endorsement.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video successfully pairs emotional wedding content with a technological gimmick, creating a high-retention social media clip that effectively advertises the camera brand used.
